title.english: Wet Wood Has No School Bell

pairs.target: dìèrtiān yìzǎo , xiāngzǐ kǎzhù le . sū yǐ dūn zài shuǐkǒu biān , liǎng shǒuwòzhe wàicè de tí bǎ , shì le liǎngcì dōu méi tí dòng .
pairs.english: Early the next morning, the box jammed. Suyi crouched by the intake, gripping the outer handles with both hands, but couldn't lift it in two tries.
pairs.hanzi:
第二天一早，箱子卡住了。
苏苡蹲在水口边，两手握着外侧的提把，试了两次都没提动。

pairs.target: zuótiān kōngxiāng hái huá dé hěn shùn , yèlǐ wèi shì lòu jìnguò qīngshuǐ , mù biān zhàng qǐlái , zhènghǎo yǎozhù kuàngjià . tā méiyǒu jiào tǎ wéijiā bǎ lì , xiān bǎshǒu sōngkāi , wǎng pángbiān nuóchū dìfāng .
pairs.english: Yesterday the empty box had slid smoothly. Soaked in clean water overnight to test for leaks, its wooden edges swelled and gripped the frame. Instead of asking Tavi to pull harder, she let go and moved aside to make room.
pairs.hanzi: 昨天空箱还滑得很顺，夜里为试漏浸过清水，木边胀起来，正好咬住框架。她没有叫塔维加把力，先把手松开，往旁边挪出地方。

pairs.target: mǐlā nálái jìlùzhǐ , dìyīháng yuánběn kōng zhe , zhǔnbèi xiě shì shuǐ kāishǐ de shíkè . sū yǐ jiēguò qù , xiān xiě le bùnéng tíqǐ .
pairs.english: Mira brought the record sheet, its first line left blank for the time the water trial began. Suyi took it and first wrote: cannot lift.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉拿来记录纸，第一行原本空着，准备写试水开始的时刻。苏苡接过去，先写了不能提起。

pairs.target: táoshīfu mōlemō shī mù biān , yòu yòng báopiàn tàn guò fèng , shuō zhè búsuàn xīqí , zhǐshì tāmen zài zuōfang lǐ pào dé hái búgòu jiǔ . zhēn yòng qǐlái , mùtou búhuì tīngjiàn xiàkè zhōng , jiù zìjǐ gān huíqù .
pairs.english: Master Tao felt the wet edges and probed the gap with a thin strip. It wasn't unusual, he said; they simply hadn't soaked it long enough at the workshop. In real use, wood wouldn't dry itself again on hearing the school bell.
pairs.hanzi: 陶师傅摸了摸湿木边，又用薄片探过缝，说这不算稀奇，只是她们在作坊里泡得还不够久。真用起来，木头不会听见下课钟，就自己干回去。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhe yào qǔ páozǐ , mǐlā què ànzhù gōngjùxiāng , wèn xiāo wán zhīhòu gān le huì buhuì huàng . táoshīfu kàn tā yìyǎn , bǎ báopiàn dìgěi tā , ràng tā zìjǐ liáng yào liú duōshǎo , zài yìqǐ juédìng .
pairs.english: As he reached for a plane, Mira held down the toolbox and asked whether it would wobble once shaved and dry. Tao glanced at her, gave her the strip, and had her measure the allowance herself before they decided together.
pairs.hanzi: 他说着要取刨子，米拉却按住工具箱，问削完之后干了会不会晃。陶师傅看她一眼，把薄片递给她，让她自己量要留多少，再一起决定。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qù shàngpō jiè píng dèng , huílái shí , nàwèi juànxiù fùrén yǐjīng tí zhe tǒng zhàn zài lǎo shù páng . tā jīntiān méi jí zhe cuī , fǎnér náchū yìzhī mó dé fābái de jiù sháo , wèn lòu xiàlái de xìshā shìbushì háiyào lìngwài yǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi went uphill to borrow a bench. When he returned, the rolled-sleeve woman was by the old tree with a bucket. Instead of hurrying them today, she produced an old spoon worn pale, asking whether fine sand slipping through still needed scooping separately.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维去上坡借平凳，回来时，那位卷袖妇人已经提着桶站在老树旁。她今天没急着催，反而拿出一只磨得发白的旧勺，问漏下来的细沙是不是还要另外舀。

pairs.target: sū yǐ shuō huì yǒu , búshì suǒyǒu xìshā dōu liú dé zhù . fùrén tīng wán , bǎ sháo gē zài cáo biān , shuō nà tā xiān bié diū .
pairs.english: Suyi said yes, not all the fine sand would be caught. The woman set the spoon beside the channel, saying she wouldn't throw it away yet.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡说会有，不是所有细沙都留得住。妇人听完，把勺搁在槽边，说那她先别丢。

pairs.target: páo diào de mùxiè shīruǎn , nián zài táoshīfu zhǐjié shàng . tā zhī xiū xiāng biān , méiyǒu dòng jiù cáo . kuàngjià lǐ de dǎo piàn yě chóngxīn tuì kāi yìdiǎn , liúchū mùtou jìxù zhàng suō de yúdì .
pairs.english: The shavings were damp and soft, sticking to Tao's knuckles. He trimmed only the box edges, leaving the old channel untouched. The guide inside the frame was also moved back a little, allowing for further swelling and shrinking.
pairs.hanzi: 刨掉的木屑湿软，粘在陶师傅指节上。他只修箱边，没有动旧槽。框架里的导片也重新退开一点，留出木头继续胀缩的余地。

pairs.target: shì tí shí , liǎngzhī xiāng gèzì néng cóng wàibiān táiqǐ , búzài xūyào rén tànshēn yuèguò lìngyìzhī ; pángbiān de rén réng dé tuì kāi , bùnéng dāngzhe tǒng luànjǐ .
pairs.english: In the lifting test, each box could be raised from the outside without leaning across the other; bystanders still had to step back and couldn't jostle around the buckets.
pairs.hanzi: 试提时，两只箱各自能从外边抬起，不再需要人探身越过另一只；旁边的人仍得退开，不能当着桶乱挤。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhèngyào bǎ shǒushàng de shuǐ shuǎidiào , fùrén bǎtǒng huàn dào zuǒbiān , shēnshǒu lái shì . tā guànyòng zuǒshǒu , zhuā tí bǎ shí gēbozhǒu dǐng zhe shàngpō nàgēn zhī jiǎo , shǒuwàn bùdébù nǐng guòqù .
pairs.english: As Mira shook water from her hands, the woman moved her bucket left and reached out to try. Left-handed, she found her elbow against the uphill support leg when grasping the handle, forcing her wrist to twist.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉正要把手上的水甩掉，妇人把桶换到左边，伸手来试。她惯用左手，抓提把时胳膊肘顶着上坡那根支脚，手腕不得不拧过去。

pairs.target: mǐlā gāng xiǎng shuō lìngyìbiān hǎo tí , huà méi chūkǒu , xiān zìjǐ huàn zuǒshǒu shì le yícì . tā de gēbo yě zhuàng shàng le .
pairs.english: Mira almost said it was easier on the other side, but tried it left-handed herself before speaking. Her arm hit it too.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉刚想说另一边好提，话没出口，先自己换左手试了一次。
她的胳膊也撞上了。

pairs.target: " zhègēn néng wǎng lǐ shōu ma ? " tā wèn sū yǐ . " xiān kàn xiāngzǐ tídào dǐng , dǐxià hái gòubugòu . "
pairs.english: “Can this leg move inward?” she asked Suyi. “First see if there's enough room underneath when the box is fully raised.”
pairs.hanzi:
“这根能往里收吗？”她问苏苡。
“先看箱子提到顶，底下还够不够。”

pairs.target: liǎng rén méiyǒu gè gǎi gè de . sū yǐ ná chǐ , mǐlā tái xiāng , táoshīfu kàn chéngtuō de wèizhì , tǎ wéi bào zhe yì jié diànmù děng tāmen xūyào .
pairs.english: They didn't make separate alterations. Suyi held the ruler, Mira lifted the box, Tao checked the support positions, and Tavi held a length of packing wood ready for them.
pairs.hanzi: 两人没有各改各的。苏苡拿尺，米拉抬箱，陶师傅看承托的位置，塔维抱着一截垫木等他们需要。

pairs.target: tiáo wán hòu , yòu qǐng fùrén zhào yuánlái de zīshì zǒuyíbiàn . tā shì dào dìsāncì , hūrán shuō zìjǐ yě yǒudiǎn gùyì tiāomáobìng , xiǎng kànkàn tāmen shìbushì zhī yuànyì tīng hǎohuà .
pairs.english: After adjusting it, they asked the woman to repeat her original movements. On her third try she suddenly admitted she was being a little deliberately picky, to see whether they only wanted praise.
pairs.hanzi: 调完后，又请妇人照原来的姿势走一遍。她试到第三次，忽然说自己也有点故意挑毛病，想看看她们是不是只愿意听好话。

pairs.target: " tiāo ba . " mǐlā shuō , yǔqì réng yìng , " bié děng zǒu le zài mà . " fùrén xiào le , ná jiù sháo qiāo yíxià tǒng yán .
pairs.english: “Go ahead,” Mira said, still brusque. “Don't wait until we're gone to complain.” The woman laughed and tapped the bucket rim with her old spoon.
pairs.hanzi:
“挑吧。”米拉说，语气仍硬，“别等走了再骂。”
妇人笑了，拿旧勺敲一下桶沿。

pairs.target: jiējìn zhōngwǔ , táoshīfu cái zhǔnxǔ jiēshàng fēn chūlái de shìyòng shuǐlù . yuán cáo réng néng zhàocháng qǔshuǐ , yàngjiàn zhī jiē pángbiān de yìgǔ , bùnéng dǎngzhù píngcháng yòngshuǐ de kǒuzǐ .
pairs.english: Not until almost noon did Tao allow them to connect the diverted trial watercourse. The old channel still supplied water as usual; the prototype took only a side stream and mustn't block the normal intake.
pairs.hanzi: 接近中午，陶师傅才准许接上分出来的试用水路。原槽仍能照常取水，样件只接旁边的一股，不能挡住平常用水的口子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài pángbiān , kàn hún yìdiǎn de shuǐchōng jìn xiāng lǐ , yèpiàn bèi dǎoxiàng néng qǔchū de gélán , lìngyícè jiànjiàn liúchū shuǐ lái .
pairs.english: Tavi stood nearby, watching slightly cloudy water rush into the box, leaves directed toward the removable screen while water gradually flowed out the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在旁边，看浑一点的水冲进箱里，叶片被导向能取出的隔栏，另一侧渐渐流出水来。

pairs.target: méiyǒu rén huānhū . fùrén xiān zhuāng le bàntǒng , dūnxià kàn dǐ , zhǐchū réng yǒu shā . lìng yígè yòngshuǐ de nánrén juéde tí bǎ háishì dī , chuānhòu yīfu huì bú shùnshǒu .
pairs.english: Nobody cheered. The woman filled half a bucket, crouched to inspect the bottom, and pointed out remaining sand. Another user, a man, thought the handles still low and awkward with thick clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 没有人欢呼。妇人先装了半桶，蹲下看底，指出仍有沙。另一个用水的男人觉得提把还是低，穿厚衣服会不顺手。

pairs.target: sū yǐ dōu jìxià le , mǐlā dūn zài tāmen pángbiān , bùshí dǐng yíjù zuǐ , dǐng wán zài shì .
pairs.english: Suyi noted it all. Mira crouched beside them, occasionally talking back, then trying again.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡都记下了，米拉蹲在他们旁边，不时顶一句嘴，顶完再试。

pairs.target: tāmen zuìhòu shāngdìng xiān liúyòng qītiān , měitiān yóu táoshīfu ānpái de běndì mùgōng jiǎnchá kuàngjià , zhùhù zhī zhào yǎnshì de fāngfǎ qīnglǐ , kǎzhù jiù tíng , bú yìng qiào .
pairs.english: They finally agreed to leave it for seven days, with the local carpenter arranged by Tao checking the frame daily. Households would clean it only as demonstrated, stopping if it jammed, without forcing it.
pairs.hanzi: 他们最后商定先留用七天，每天由陶师傅安排的本地木工检查框架，住户只照演示的方法清理，卡住就停，不硬撬。

pairs.target: mǐlā fùqīn fùzé bǎ jìlù dàigěi zuōfang , bú tì nǚér bǎ huàichù shāndiào . táoshīfu gé le bàntiān cái dāying bù dāngchǎng chāi zǒu , chū ménqián yòu qīnshǒu jiǎnchá le yìhuí .
pairs.english: Mira's father would take the records to the workshop, without editing away the faults for his daughter. It took half a day before Tao agreed not to dismantle it on the spot; before leaving, he checked it himself once more.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉父亲负责把记录带给作坊，不替女儿把坏处删掉。陶师傅隔了半天才答应不当场拆走，出门前又亲手检查了一回。

pairs.target: dìèryè réng zhù zài mǐlā jiā . wǎnfàn hòu , tā bǎ jīntiān nà zhāng mǎn shì shuǐyìn de zhǐ hé sū yǐ de jìlù fàngzài yìqǐ , kànzhe kànzhe , hūrán shuō zuōfang lǐ nàge gānjìng móxíng yǒudiǎn tǎoyàn .
pairs.english: They spent the second night at Mira's home too. After supper she put the water-stained sheet with Suyi's records, studied them, and suddenly said the clean workshop model was a little irritating.
pairs.hanzi: 第二夜仍住在米拉家。晚饭后，她把今天那张满是水印的纸和苏苡的记录放在一起，看着看着，忽然说作坊里那个干净模型有点讨厌。

pairs.target: sū yǐ tǎng zài jièlái de pūgài shàng , shuō bié tǎoyàn , dàihuíqù hái dé yòng .
pairs.english: Lying on borrowed bedding, Suyi said not to hate it: they'd still need it back there.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡躺在借来的铺盖上，说别讨厌，带回去还得用。

pairs.target: dìsāntiān xiàwǔ huíxiào , tǎ wéi de wàiyī yǐjīng duō mópò yíchù . mǐlā bǎ kòuzǐ háigěi tā , shuō bǔyī de qián tā chū . tā wèn néng bunéng huàn liǎngdùn bǐng , tā xiǎng le yíxià , shuō yídùn bàn .
pairs.english: Returning to school on the third afternoon, Tavi's coat had another worn hole. Mira returned the buttons and offered to pay for mending. He asked whether he could have two flatbread meals instead; she considered, then said one and a half.
pairs.hanzi: 第三天下午回校，塔维的外衣已经多磨破一处。米拉把扣子还给他，说补衣的钱她出。他问能不能换两顿饼，她想了一下，说一顿半。

pairs.target: chēlún yòu niǎnguò páishuǐ shí . sū yǐ zài pángbiān xiào dé dīxiàtóu , zhè yícì , shuí yě méi zhuàng shàng chēpéng .
pairs.english: The wheels rolled over drainage stones again. Suyi bent her head laughing beside them; this time nobody hit the canopy.
pairs.hanzi: 车轮又碾过排水石。苏苡在旁边笑得低下头，这一次，谁也没撞上车篷。
